messages.snippet: All, The document management system and Exchange will be unavailable from 22:00 on Saturday 21 March
messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: DMS and email — Saturday 21 March
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system and Exchange will be unavailable from 22:00 on Saturday 21 March until 04:00 Sunday 22 March for scheduled maintenance. Please save and close all documents before you leave on Saturday. No action is required.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
